tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "86E671384290AD6EA87EC48DAA7BCC38", "As Settlements develop, Mayors may choose to construct new Service Buildings. Keep an eye out for plots under construction!")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "4671D9424E212606177F098A658EAC7A", "Construction Crates can be delivered directly to scaffolding to aid with constriction. Interact with a plot under construction to see what they require and deliver them to increase building progress.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "481D31804DB9519DF9F19485C064AA74", "Once enough Construcion Crates have been collected, construction will begin. Work together with your fellow citizens to to develop your Settlement, and enjoy the fruits of your labor!")
